name: Alatau City Bank
note: Partner of Barys Astana for 2026/27 (club partnership page; logo on alataucitybank.kz). Formerly Jusan Bank; Vyacheslav Kim (Kaspi.kz co-founder) completed its acquisition in July 2025 and is named by press as sole shareholder (claim alatau-city-bank-kim-owner). No state in the chain and no human-rights finding against the bank or Kim found. Proposed tier: none (for a maintainer).
